set_text.text: Before you plan a buy around capacity
Capacity is only as true as the building figure and the flow you enter. A buyer planning against it should confirm each of these.

VOS does not measure your building or run your warehouse. It sits on the order side: every order placed by voice in the VOS app arrives with a number, date and timestamp. Those dated app orders give one check on the monthly cases you enter.
Find your days on hand and turns a year, and how much cash a shorter stay on the shelf would free.
